item.title: Would a Firing Squad Have Been More 'Humane' for Christa Pike?
item.description:
Christa Pike, the Tennessee woman convicted of murdering Colleen Slemmer in 1995 , was a dead woman walking Wednesday. Whether or when she will walk again remains to be seen. But, as of Thursday evening, she was alive, having survived the state's attempt to execute her via lethal injection. Twice. Put differently, it did not go as planned.
